angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 779,184 km at 215.95 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.6308 +/- 0.0116 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 215.95 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.12 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TrES-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 779,184 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.36 +/- 0.3 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TrES-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5850 +/- 50 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tres-2.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.473, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-2 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from O'Donovan et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...651L..61O/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-1: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-2 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.15 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-2 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.03841, from Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-2 (pscomppars): age 3.55 Gyr, from Morton et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-2 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1 km/s, from Winn et al. 2008 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...682.1283W/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
